jobs.name: bench-c7a16
jobs.command:
lscpu > "$GTU_OUT/lscpu.txt"; nproc > "$GTU_OUT/nproc.txt"; git rev-parse HEAD > "$GTU_OUT/commit.txt"
T0=$(date +%s); bash routes/gtu/platform/su2/install_su2.sh "$HOME/su2" "$HOME/SU2-src" > "$GTU_OUT/su2_build.log" 2>&1; echo $(( $(date +%s) - T0 )) > "$GTU_OUT/su2_build_s.txt"
export SU2_RUN="$HOME/su2/bin"
python routes/gtu/platform/su2/run_case.py --case taurus60 --level medium --plan design --np "$(nproc)" --mpi-args "" --time-limit 7200 --su2-src "$HOME/SU2-src" --out "$GTU_OUT/taurus60_medium"
